title: yosoi::action::run_module_with_export
signature: pub fn run_module_with_export(path: impl AsRef<std::path::Path>, export_name: impl Into<String>) -> Result<yosoi::flow::Step, yosoi::action::JavaScriptModuleError>
docs:
Snapshots an entry module and its local relative import graph with an
optional selected export returned as JSON after module evaluation.
The selected export is read, never invoked.
